A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to conduct a Public Hearing and adopt one of the following resolutions as
  Resolution No. 029­2025:
  1. A Resolution affirming the Planning Commission’s decision to approve a Minor Use Permit
  for a proposed boat sales business located at 12347 E. Carson Street and determining that
  the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); or

  2. A Resolution overturning the Planning Commission’s decision and denying a Minor Use
  Permit for a proposed boat sales business located at 12347 E. Carson Street and
  determining that the project is categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act (CEQA).

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Either affirm the decision of the Planning Commission and approve the
  MUP subject to the same or different conditions of approval or overturn the Planning Commission’s
  decision and adopt appropriate findings to deny the MUP.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, explained the hearing process.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, spoke.

  Andrew Hard, applicant, provided a presentation.

  Mayor De Paula spoke.
